ElevenLabs - AI-powered text-to-speech and voice cloning technology. #freemium

summary.name: ElevenLabs
summary.one_liner: ElevenLabs is an AI voice platform for text-to-speech, voice cloning, speech-to-text, music and sound effect generation, and conversational voice agents.
use_cases: Localizing product updates and video dubbing
Building voice or chat customer service agents
Generating music and sound effects for film or ads
summary.what_it_does: The page describes two platforms: ElevenCreative, for generating speech, videos, music and sound effects and editing podcasts, audiobooks and voiceovers, and ElevenAgents, for configuring, deploying and monitoring conversational agents over voice or chat. It lists a Text to Speech API with several models (Eleven Flash at 75ms latency, Eleven Multilingual, Eleven v4) supporting 29+ languages, and a Speech to Text API (Eleven Scribe) with speaker diarization and character-level timestamps. Voice features include cloning a voice, designing one from a prompt, or using a library of 17,500+ voices. The page also lists a Music API and an image and video section that uses third-party models such as Veo, Wan, Kling and Seedance.
notable: Voice cloning and prompt-designed voices with a library of 17,500+ voices
Text to speech and speech to text APIs with low-latency model options
Music generation built with artists, labels and publishers, cleared for commercial use
Agent platform with analytics, testing, guardrails and workflows
caveats: Commercial rights for music vary by subscription tier
Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page; the freemium label comes from the directory listing
